text:
maria.pm: Drafting PRD section for security/compliance around audit logs, KMS/HSM, and retention. Need quick alignment on MVP vs enterprise scope.

ashley.eng: thanks — can you paste the current acceptance criteria you have? want to check implementation impact.

maria.pm: pasted below (first draft). aiming for MVP launch in Q2 if we keep scope tight. thoughts?

maria.pm: ```
MVP acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Audit logs for inference requests emitted to immutable append-only store.
- Default retention = 90 days, searchable via Console and API.
- Logs encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS option (cloud KMS) for enterprise.
- Key rotation supported via KMS; HSM-backed keys optional for enterprise agreements.
- SOC2 control mapping doc linked and reviewed by security.
```

samir.sec: high-level: 👍 on 90d default. need to call out PII scrubbing rules + access controls and retention override requests. also clarify "immutable" (WORM?) for audit purposes.

ashley.eng: implementation notes: 90d default is fine. we can stream logs to S3 with object lock for WORM in enterprise tenants. cloud KMS plumb is straightforward. HSM (PKCS#11) adds deployment/ops work — on Private customers only?

jordan.prodops: WORM via S3 object lock makes sense for Dedicated/Private. For hosted customers we need a policy doc to explain cost and retention tradeoffs. also ask: will retention be per-customer config?

maria.pm: yes per-customer config with org-level default. UI + API to set retention_days (min 30, max 3650 for enterprise contracts). default 90.

kevin.legal: flag: legal requires audit-grade retention for regulated customers (finance/health). we may need 7+ years in some contracts — so allow >3650? recommend escalation path to sales + legal for >3650. also data export/subpoena procedures must be documented.

samir.sec: Also need to specify key custody models in PRD:
- Hosted: Redwood-managed keys (default) + customer-managed KMS (cloud provider) option.
- Dedicated: customer KMS required for certain contracts.
- Private/on-prem: HSM/KMS integration (PKCS#11) + offline key import option.

ashley.eng: edge case: customer requests immediate deletion of logs for GDPR subject request. retention policy must allow deletions, but that conflicts with audit needs. we need a rule: deletion requests are honored unless a legal hold is active. need to put that into acceptance criteria.

maria.pm: good point. update PRD snippet: ```
- Retention override API: POST /orgs/:id/retention { days: N } (min 30 default).
- Delete-on-request flow: GDPR deletion requests executed unless active legal hold; legal hold supersedes retention.
```

samir.sec: add auditability: any retention change or deletion must produce an immutable admin-audit event stored separately (write-only) and retained for min 7 years for compliance customers.

jordan.prodops: rollout plan suggestion:
- Phase 1 (MVP): hosted + dedicated basic KMS, 90d default, per-org retention config, UI+API.
- Phase 2 (Enterprise): S3 object lock WORM, HSM integration for Private, retention windows >3650 via contract, legal-hold workflows, long-term admin-audit retention.

ashley.eng: rough implementation risks:
- KMS integration timeline depends on cloud provider APIs (rotation hooks).
- HSM drivers require QA for on-prem networks.
- Storage cost for long retention; need quota model per customer.

maria.pm: launch criteria idea: 
1) Security review completed and sign-off from @samir.sec.
2) Implementation of encryption at rest + KMS option verified in staging.
3) Retention config test coverage + e2e for deletion/legal hold.
4) Docs + customer-facing guidance published.
5) Prod observability: token-level cost and retention telemetry enabled.

samir.sec: add: SOC2/ISO mapping doc and tabletop exercise passed for two scenarios (data-subject request, subpoena).

kevin.legal: add compliance checklist item: eDiscovery/export process and retention schedule templates for sales to include in contracts.

maria.pm: scope negotiation question: are we comfortable shipping MVP without HSM support and >1yr retention? that keeps Q2 realistic.

ashley.eng: yes for MVP we skip HSM and multi-year retention. we should provide clear enterprise path and include a "silver-gtc" add-on in docs so sales can set expectations.

samir.sec: agreed. we'll treat HSM + 7+ years retention as enterprise feature gated by contract and dedicated infra.

jordan.prodops: ops items: quota + billing for long retention, retention deletion background job, alerting on retention config anomalies. can own runbook for legal-hold process.

maria.pm: next steps I hear:
- I update PRD with these changes (retention override API, legal-hold rules, audit trail for admin actions).
- @samir.sec will draft SOC2/ISO mapping section.
- @ashley.eng to outline implementation estimate and risks.
- @kevin.legal to draft contract language for >1yr retention and eDiscovery.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please attach the PRD draft to this thread when updated so we can track reviews. :white_check_mark:

maria.pm: will update today and tag reviewers. thanks all! :raised_hands:
